WORKING NOTES

Try this: Try a head-and-shoulders close-up.
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with copper-red hair
swept back from her face wears a single pearl drop
earring and a black blouse with a small white
printed motif. Her expression is calm, with soft
peach lips and a direct gaze. Soft, even studio light
against a plain pale backdrop. Palette of black,
ivory, and copper. Romantic and polished, in the
style of a runway beauty editorial.
